title: Represent Rational Numbers on the Coordinate Plane
focus: Plot ordered pairs in all 4 quadrants

items.stem: Which of the following points is located in the third quadrant of the coordinate plane?
A point is plotted at (-4, 6) on the coordinate plane. Which statement describes its location? Show or explain your work.
choices: It is in the second quadrant because the x-coordinate is negative and the y-coordinate is positive.
It is in the first quadrant because both coordinates are positive.
It is in the third quadrant because both coordinates are negative.
It is in the fourth quadrant because the x-coordinate is positive and the y-coordinate is negative.

items.stem: Select ALL statements that are true about points plotted on the coordinate plane.
choices: Points in the first quadrant have positive x and y coordinates.
Points in the fourth quadrant have negative x coordinates and positive y coordinates.
The origin is the point where the x-axis and y-axis intersect, represented as (0, 0).
Points with a positive x and a negative y coordinate lie in the fourth quadrant.

items.stem: Plot the point (-3, -2) on the coordinate plane. Explain which quadrant it is located in and why. Show or explain your work.
